'''DC-10''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] who served at the [[Coruscant City Tours]].

==Behind the scenes==
DC-10 first appears in the [[1999]] [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' video game]] where she's voiced by [[Heidi Shannon]]. The player, in the guise of [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]] must talk to her in order to proceed through the level.
